notes: Reference-derived RGBA pixel frames. Every state change uses the shared smootherstep transition profile. Its dedicated lowering sequence starts from the exact closed-eye stroke endpoint, continuously blends through the existing lowering poses, and ends in the sleeping frame with matched breathing and Zzz. Scheduled sleep remains unchanged. All programmatic fang overlays remain removed. Numbered idle actions retain neutral stand endpoints.
